data.name: Nilutpal
data.gender_notes: Nilutpal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nilutpal is derived from Sanskrit words 'Nil' meaning blue and 'Utpal' meaning lotus. It represents the divine beauty of the blue lotus flower, which is a symbol of enlightenment, purity, and detachment in Hindu mythology. The name Nilutpal carries the meaning “Blue Lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nilutpal usually hope their child will grow to embody blue lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nilutpal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blue Lotus.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nilutpal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
